message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mosquitto && grep -RIn "dynsec_clients__cleanup(data)\|client__free_item(data, client)\|dynsec_clients__find(data, client->username)" plugins/dynamic-security | head -50 && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"fuzzing/plugins/dynamic-security/dynsec_fuzz_load.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":49,"var":"data","code":"fwrite(data, 1, size, fptr);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are written verbatim to a temporary config file that becomes the plugin input."},
  {"step":2,"file":"fuzzing/plugins/dynamic-security/dynsec_fuzz_load.cpp","function":"run_dynsec","line":39,"var":"filename","code":"options[0].value = filename;","note":"The temporary file path is passed to the plugin as config_file so the plugin loads the attacker-controlled file."},
  {"step":3,"file":"plugins/dynamic-security/plugin.c","function":"mosquitto_plugin_init","line":52,"var":"dynsec_data.config_file","code":"dynsec_data.config_file = mosquitto_strdup(options[i].value);","note":"Plugin initialization stores the supplied config path and proceeds to load it."},
  {"step":4,"file":"plugins/dynamic-security/clients.c","function":"dynsec_clients__config_load","line":104,"var":"j_clients","code":"j_clients = cJSON_GetObjectItem(tree, \"clients\");","note":"The JSON config is parsed and the clients array is selected from attacker-controlled input."},
  {"step":5,"file":"plugins/dynamic-security/clients.c","function":"dynsec_clients__config_load","line":116,"var":"client","code":"client = mosquitto_calloc(1, sizeof(struct dynsec__client) + username_len + 1);","note":"Each client object from the file is allocated and populated from JSON fields."},
  {"step":6,"file":"plugins/dynamic-security/clients.c","function":"dynsec_clients__config_load","line":223,"var":"data->clients","code":"HASH_ADD(hh, data->clients, username, username_len, client);","note":"Loaded clients are inserted into the global hash table, making them reachable by username."},
  {"step":7,"file":"plugins/dynamic-security/plugin.c","function":"mosquitto_plugin_cleanup","line":118,"var":"dynsec_data.clients","code":"dynsec_clients__cleanup(&dynsec_data);","note":"Cleanup iterates over the hash table and frees each client object."},
  {"step":8,"file":"plugins/dynamic-security/clients.c","function":"client__free_item","line":81,"var":"client_found","code":"client_found = dynsec_clients__find(data, client->username);","note":"During free, the code re-finds the same client by username before deleting it from the hash."},
  {"step":9,"file":"plugins/dynamic-security/clients.c","function":"client__free_item","line":83,"var":"client_found","code":"HASH_DEL(data->clients, client_found);","note":"The hash entry is removed, but the iterator in cleanup still advances using the stale next pointer from the freed item."},
  {"step":10,"file":"plugins/dynamic-security/clients.c","function":"dynsec_clients__cleanup","line":97,"var":"client_tmp","code":"HASH_ITER(hh, data->clients, client, client_tmp){ client__free_item(data, client); }","note":"HASH_ITER reads the next pointer from the just-freed client, causing a heap-use-after-free read in the cleanup path."}
]
p.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mosquitto/fuzzing/corpora/dynsec_config_seed_corpus.zip /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true` executed with exit code 0.
